titulo: Ten minutes early, and saying so
caption:
Ten minutes early, and saying so

My friend is always ten minutes early and tells me so. Then I stopped being late.

Saying how long you waited, kindly, tells people their time mattered to you.

For whoever says out loud that the wait was worth it.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right and a small digital clock that reads 4:50, then 4:55, then 5:00. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes waits on the left. At 5:00 the door opens and a royal blue figure walks in with happy eyes and a bubble that says hi! on time! The black one's eyes go wide, then happy, and a bubble says worth the wait. Both pulse. The text stays: me ten minutes early and admitting it. The last card: Choose friction.
